capability_target: GUI value tasks: identify the bottleneck by falsification before spending on an invariance lever that cannot exist there.
causal_blocker: The GUI side was assumed to be missing the invariance that gives the code side its reach. If that were true the fix would be a quotient machinery. It is false: the identity arms are vacuous by construction (the value algebra never reads index/name/id as a term -- index appears once, at derived_value_v1:397, only as the ADDRESS of the field to type into) and the judge has no quotient (4 of 5 pages accept exactly one spelling; text-transform scores ZC5F 1 and F5CZ -1; enter-time rejects the utterance's own 1:13 PM). The real blocker is operand vocabulary, of which enter-time's 12h->24h rewrite is the first measured member.
expected_parent_change: Spend on the operand vocabulary -- specifically on operands that are rewrites in the world rather than content on the page -- because that is the only one of the two candidate diagnoses that survived measurement.
expected_parent_frontier_change: Capability growth is aimed at the observable rather than at the experience: the blocking certificate names 18 sites that share every fact and differ, and a predictor is only allowed to veto, never to license, so the proof stays the safety boundary while learning buys speed.
falsification_condition: A GUI value page whose judge accepts a semantically different answer -- i.e. a pair of distinct strings, differing in more than the page's own tokenization, that both score 1 -- would refute "no non-trivial quotient" and reopen the invariance route.
highest_leverage_now: Spend on the operand vocabulary -- specifically on operands that are rewrites in the world rather than content on the page -- because that is the only one of the two candidate diagnoses that survived measurement.

recursive_obs.stop_condition: One merged change on this branch whose three arms and certificate are reproducible from the receipt by one command.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: Every cheaper route was tried against a real artifact and refused: the crystallizer's token anti-unification cannot express position-level containment and has no site context, and the existing repair primitive has no ast.AugAssign rule at all. Inducing a template from one demonstration pair and letting the corpus's own tests decide costs two runs; adding another hand-written mutation kind would lift one bug of forty and leave the question unmeasured.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It replaces a list with a fold over experience and reuses the existing repair primitive, the corpus oracle and the hashing/verification discipline; the only new machinery is induction and the rung classifier, and both are measured.

stop_condition: Both arms measured on the declared 5-page design set and the 123-page jsdom surface; verdicts recorded; no invariance machinery built.
terminal_objective: Identify the GUI bottleneck by falsification rather than by assumption.
truth: The GUI value task is a total equality checked by string comparison, so it admits no non-trivial invariance. The code-side lever does not transfer, and the limitation is vocabulary, not invariance.

v22_prewrite_admission.proof_state_reachability: This makes the reachable edit space a measured property for coding repair; it discharges no truth obligation.
